verdict.rationale: Filee's own docs say DOCX → HWPX conversion keeps page setup, headers and footers, tables with merged cells, text boxes and pictures, and that Excel converts to PDF with Excel-like page fitting. That covers layout, tables and images, but only for specific routes and only from vendor claims. Font-file conversion (TTF/WOFF) is a different capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: font preservation during document conversion, fidelity claims for other routes (e.g. PDF→Word, PowerPoint, HWP), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, document conversion preserves layout, fonts, images, and tables rather than flattening them

citations.quote: DOCX → HWPX keeps page setup, headers and footers, tables with merged cells, text boxes and pictures
Excel, OpenDocument and CSV/TSV sheets, to PDF with Excel-like page fitting
